Only the default-delimiter tokenizer (_REGEX_STRING and parseTemplateText)
is adapted. The adaptation adds source offsets and exports a pure ESM function.
It excludes EJS compilation, rendering, cache, include and filesystem code.

Nested-delimiter grouping in source-units.mjs is independently implemented
for the documented ST-Prompt-Template behavior; no AGPL implementation is copied.
